renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Use ONLY the claims in the ESSENCE list below; every paragraph must correspond to at least one essence item (record indices). Do not add doctrines, comparisons, meta-commentary, or quoted terms. ESSENCE: [0] Variety totalized: extremes, three directions, outer-inner one list.

paragraphs.text: Variety gets listed in full, nothing left out: the highest and the lowest, the three directions, and the outer and inner worlds all on one single list.
Total inventory: extremes, three ways, outer-inner undivided. Completeness is the point.

paragraphs.text: The catalogue is total: top, bottom, all three directions, outer and inner as one list. No abridgment.
Extremes plus directions plus outer-inner, one list. All of variety, itemized.
